class.name: NNIntRangeSensor
class.brief_description: Accepts a minimum and maximum value that defines a value range. The input value given is scaled to 0..1 range within the given min and max values.
class.description: Normalises [member range_value] linearly across the interval from [member range_min_value] ([code]0.0[/code]) to [member range_max_value] ([code]1.0[/code]) when evaluated, clamping the resulting [member NNSensors.sensor_value] to [code]0.0..1.0[/code]. If [member range_min_value] is greater than or equal to [member range_max_value] (equal or reversed bounds), [member NNSensors.sensor_value] evaluates to [code]0.0[/code].

members.member: Upper bound of the input range, mapping to [code]1.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. Equal or reversed bounds evaluate to [code]0.0[/code].
Lower bound of the input range, mapping to [code]0.0[/code] for [member NNSensors.sensor_value].

Raw input value for the sensor, normalised between [member range_min_value] and [member range_max_value] into [code]0..1[/code] on evaluation. Assignments outside those bounds are immediately clamped.
